rv.q: The effect, in Matthew Lenton’s high-precision production, is to turn a stressful night on the wards into something like gothic horror.
This co-production by Vanishing Point and Denmark’s Teater Katapult follows Flora, an overworked nurse, reliving a traumatic night shift.
An odd emotional lacuna in the script by Josephine Eusebius ultimately limits the drama’s impact, however.

cn.t: Critics praise this visually striking international collaboration between Vanishing Point and Teater Katapult, commending its bold design choices and compelling portrayal of a nurse's grueling hospital shift during the winter solstice.
